rss_feeds.name: OWASP Threat Intelligence Feed
rss_feeds.notes: OWASP-maintained threat intelligence RSS feed and related API; monitor for identity and authorization vulnerabilities affecting verification infrastructure.

rss_feeds.name: ESET WeLiveSecurity
rss_feeds.notes: ESET research and threat-intelligence publication; monitor for breach, malware, and identity-fraud investigations.

rss_feeds.name: Identity Week
rss_feeds.notes: Digital identity, biometrics, border-control, and identity-wallet industry coverage; useful for provider and government eID incident discovery.

rss_feeds.name: Identity at the Core Breach Feed
rss_feeds.notes: Identity-focused aggregated breach/advisory feed combining sources such as CISA, Krebs, and BleepingComputer, filtered for IAM relevance.

apis.name: GitHub Advisory Database REST API
apis.notes: Free API for global CVEs and GitHub-originated security advisories. Use for security vulnerabilities in open-source identity/verification SDKs, not as proof that a company was breached.

apis.name: OWASP Threat Intelligence API
apis.notes: Machine-readable OWASP threat intelligence endpoint for monitoring emerging vulnerabilities that could affect identity-verification implementations.

regulatory_and_public_sources.name: Ghana National Identification Authority
regulatory_and_public_sources.notes: Official source for Ghana Card and national biometric identity system updates.

regulatory_and_public_sources.name: Uganda NIRA
regulatory_and_public_sources.notes: Official source for Uganda's National Identification Register and biometric ID updates.

regulatory_and_public_sources.name: Android Developer Verification
regulatory_and_public_sources.notes: Official Google documentation for the global developer identity verification rollout; monitor for security and privacy disclosures.
